_note: Each day can override patience_mistake_penalty from balance.json (day 1 does, to keep the tutorial forgiving). Memo intros that say 'about N students' must match students; tests check it.

1.intro: Welcome to Window 3! Today is prep week—about 8 early clearance applicants are lined up so you can learn the ropes. I'll guide you through scanning IDs, flagging mismatches, approvals, and rejections.

rules.text: Scan the student ID (press S or drag it to the reader) to inspect their ISMIS record.
Click a mismatched field on the paper and on ISMIS to flag it. Everything complete? Approve (1).
Missing a clearance item? Turn away (5) and tick the exact items they need to bring.

2.intro: Good morning! Prep week is over—real enrollment starts today. Graduating seniors are filing their clearances, about 16 before noon. Keep the queue moving and watch for impatient faces.

rules.text: Graduating students need every clearance requirement attached. Missing one? Return the form with the exact list.
Impatient students (sweat drop, scowl) drain line patience twice as fast. Click GRAD or PWD faces in the line to call them early.

3.intro: Third years enroll today. Some sections will fill up fast.

rules.text: Section full? Fix: move them to an open section with no schedule clash. Their section still has seats? Then there's nothing to fix.
Short forms are fine: Ma. for Maria, J. for Juan, BS IT for BSIT. Don't flag them.

4.intro: Second years today. The Cashier gets busy after 10:00.

rules.text: Unpaid balance in ISMIS? Send the student to the Cashier first.
Some students will ask for favors. Ma'am Lorna spot-checks three of your transactions at the end of every day.

5.intro: Freshmen day. Many of them have never logged in to ISMIS before.

rules.text: Freshman can't log in to ISMIS? Reset their account at the window.
Before resetting, the birthday on the admission slip must match ISMIS. If it doesn't, turn them away.
Two problems? Turn away beats everything. Otherwise send them to any office they need. Fixes at the window come last.

6.intro: Open market! Every year level at once, and slots drain live. Stay sharp.

rules.text: Check the Grades tab: a 5.0 in the prerequisite means reject. An INC goes to Consultation.

7.intro: Add/drop starts today. Expect a busy line, about 18 students before noon.

rules.text: Adding a subject needs the adviser's signature on the consultation slip. No signature? Send them to Consultation.
Check every signature against the adviser specimen sheet. Fakes are rejected.
Consultation on break? Put the student on the Hold bench until it reopens.

8.intro: Overload requests start today. The Dean's office takes them until 11:30.

rules.text: Over 24 units is an overload. Send it to the Dean's office.

9.intro: Extension day, the last chance to adjust. Only two departments are on the list. Expect about 14 students.

rules.text: Only Accountancy and Civil Engineering may add or enroll today. Check the Department in ISMIS. Anyone else? Turn away (5), then pick Wrong department.
